component.name: OnScreen
component.summary: Watch and listen to your own media server

description.p: OnScreen is the desktop app for OnScreen Media Server, free and open-source software you run on your own computer or NAS. Connect the app to your server to browse and play the movies, shows, music, audiobooks, podcasts and photos you have added to it.
The app includes no media of its own: it needs an OnScreen server, which you install separately.

ul.li: Movies, TV shows, music, audiobooks, podcasts and photos from your libraries
Continue Watching, Next Up and your Watchlist, synced with the other OnScreen apps
A native audio engine for lossless music, with gapless playback
Media keys, a tray icon and now-playing controls in the desktop shell
Your sign-in kept in the system keyring
No ads, no analytics and no tracking: the app talks only to the server you choose

screenshot.caption: Connecting the app to your OnScreen server

description.p: First release on Flathub, the same app as the OnScreen 2.7.0 desktop installers.
